name: augur-theme
title: Augur Theme
author: jubalm
description: Augur semantic light/dark theme: generated base tokens, shadcn-compatible role mappings, focus and reduced-motion behavior, and self-hosted Sora + Schibsted Grotesk fonts.
docs: Apply the theme by setting `data-theme="light|dark"` or the `.dark` class on `<html>` or any container; without either the system preference decides. All installed rules sit in `@layer augur`. Do not import @augurproject/design-system from registry-installed source; this item is self-contained.
